intentAndPurpose.intent: Non-interactive status/presence indicator dot. Supports multi-accent appearance roles and five sizes.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent appearance role. Figma public set; `brand-bg` is a code-only extension. `'auto'` resolves to surface appearance, else slot parent, else `'primary'`. Default: `'auto'`.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hide from assistive technology when the parent already exposes the status.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label describing the indicator status. Required for meaningful status; omit when `aria-hidden` (decorative, parent names the status).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name (code-only; not a Figma component property)

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test automation id — forwarded to the root `<span role="status">`.

props.name: size
props.description: IndicatorBadge size. Default: 'm'. Figma: xs | s | m | l | xl.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles (code-only; not a Figma component property)
